headline.text: Asked for playful ideas, then for a fixed scope and two conditions

observations.text: While brainstorming, the user invited five ideas and asked for a playful tone. The exact words are not supplied.
During implementation, the user had selected one idea. The user then asked the assistant to keep to this scope until it works.
After a failed retry, the user asked the assistant to follow the two conditions already given. The assistant had omitted one of them.

interpretation.text: In these records, the user asked for open, playful ideas when brainstorming. When building and fixing, the user asked the assistant to stay within a set scope and set conditions. This is tentative.

alternative: The difference may come from the tasks, not from how the user likes to work. A omitted condition may have led to the restated request, and the scope request may reflect this project's needs.
limitation: The two conditions are not supplied. We also do not know whether K1, K2 and K4 belong to the same project or how they are ordered.
